_rule_engine.canvas: 1080x1080 square Manim window, centered at y in [420, 1500] on 1080x1920 vertical canvas
_rule_engine.theme: Pure Monochrome Shining White (#FFFFFF, #E2E8F0) on Black Glossy Background (#000000)
_rule_engine.pacing: Minimum 2-4 visual changes per minute (~15-second pacing, 8-12 scenes for 120-180s clip)
_rule_engine.visual_philosophy: Super-Dumb bold figurative storytelling. Zero small telemetry/data clutter.
_rule_engine.line_weights: Bold 4px-14px lines with luminous glows. No super-thin lines.
_rule_engine.safe_zones: Captions at y≈500..555. Top chrome y in [0, 450] strictly clear.
